“I don’t know how much time I have left but I know that at least I’m able to touch the ball and get on the court, and it feels good,” he said.

More: www.orlandosentinel.com/2026/11/14/o...

media.title: Magic’s Noah Penda makes progress but still unsure of recovery timeline
media.description: Magic forward Noah Penda said Friday night he doesn’t know when he’ll return from injury, but made it clear he’s making progress.

items.title: The Wizards will face a severely injury-depleted Magic team tonight. In addition to having Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac and Noah Penda out, the Magic have listed Anthony Black as out for tonight's game because of right ankle injury management.
items.author: Josh Robbins
